hero.filename: Eglwys Llangadwaladr church, Ynys Mon (Anglesey), Cymru (Wales) 03.jpg
hero.caption: St Cadwaladr's Church is a Grade I listed church in Llangadwaladr, Anglesey. The nave is dated to the 12th to early 13th century and the chancel to the 14th. The 'Cadfan Stone' commemorates King Cadfan of Gwynedd, Cadwaladr’s grandfather, who died in 625.
